_note_p0_2_search_profile: P0-2 T5: search_profile replicates ruleset_aliases_for contains('cyberpunk') logic. Legacy set preferred_sections to the same list for ALL skills; here broken into per-skill subsets (equivalence: every section in the legacy array appears under at least one skill key; skills not listed fall back to generic base). field_aliases replicate the two legacy overrides: target_number->DV and armor->SP.
_note: Read-time kernel override applied by trpg-db load_rule_kernel (merge by track id, new ids appended; override wins). Heals a pass-one reader under-extraction (same hazard as triangle_agency commendations/demerits): the reader captured hp/wound_state but omitted the two runtime pools the GM operates during play. luck (core p170-ish, 'Beat The Reaper'): the LUCK Pool holds points equal to the LUCK STAT and refills at the beginning of each game session; BEFORE rolling, the player spends any portion 1-for-1 to add +1 per point to a Skill/Stat Check; never on Believability Checks. Pool size is the per-character LUCK STAT, so 'initial'/'max' are OMITTED on purpose (fail-closed; seeds from sheet_json.resources.luck where chargen emits it, else GM set). humanity (p81/p229): starts at EMP x10; lost mainly through cyberware installation (per-item Humanity Loss rolls) and trauma (1D6 traumatic event, 2D6 long-term stress); EMP = current Humanity / 10 rounded down — every drop of the tens place lowers EMP; recovered only via therapy (standard 2D6, extreme 4D6); at EMP 0 cyberpsychosis, and with NEGATIVE Humanity extreme cyberpsychosis (character becomes an NPC under GM control until Humanity is positive again). Improvement Points and Reputation are intentionally NOT kernel tracks: IP is advancement bookkeeping in the character-growth track layer (sheet_json.tracks), REP is an accrue-only social level compared in Facedowns, never spent. NO on_outcome on either track on purpose: spends/losses are GM adjudication (cyberware items, therapy, session reset), not a check-outcome field — an invented '=field' ref would be a dead rule the finalize guard drops. Pure data, no per-ruleset Rust.

resource_tracks.name: Luck
resource_tracks.notes: Runtime spend pool. Holds LUCK Points equal to the character's LUCK Statistic; refills to full at the beginning of each game session. Before rolling a Check, spend any number of remaining points to add +1 per point to that roll. Can never be spent on a Believability Check.

resource_tracks.name: Humanity
resource_tracks.zero_means: cyberpsychosis; with negative Humanity the character becomes an NPC under GM control

thresholds.consequence: EMP 0: cyberpsychosis; negative Humanity: extreme cyberpsychosis — character is handed to the GM as an NPC until Humanity is positive again

resource_tracks.notes: Starts at EMP x10 (seeded from the character's derived sheet resources). Lost mainly through installing cyberware (per-item Humanity Loss) and through trauma (1D6 traumatic physical/mental incident, 2D6 long-term stress). Current EMP = Humanity / 10 rounded down: each drop of the tens place lowers EMP. Recovered only through therapy: standard 2D6 (DV15, 500eb), extreme 4D6 (DV17, 1000eb).

_note_skill_stat_links: L-U engine-dehardcode: heals a reader under-extraction (same hazard as the luck/humanity track note). The CPR Core skill list (p131-152) organizes every skill under its governing STAT — a Skill Check is '1d10 + STAT + Skill Level vs DV' (p130 Resolving Actions with Skills). The pass-one chargen reader captured each skill's LEVEL but dropped the skill->STAT linkage, so the runtime mechanical_profile carried skill level only and roll-high checks composed '1d10 + Skill' (missing the STAT addend ~6-8) => structurally under-powered vs CPR DVs (smokeLT census: Persuasion total 8 vs DV14 = die2 + Persuasion6, COOL8 omitted). This map restores the linkage as DATA (no per-ruleset Rust). dice_core shallow-merge keeps base 'compare'. Keyed by skill TITLE (case-insensitive consumer lookup); value = STAT field in mechanical_profile.stats. Consumed by trpg-contest resolve_roll_high_modifiers (flag TRPG_SKILL_COMPETENCE_STAT, OFF==skill-only byte-equal baseline). source_ref: cyberpunk_red CPR Core p130-152 skill list.
